_howto: Every story appears once. Order = number in the image. tier: hero (3), card (9), brief (the rest). region picks the colour; utc_offset places the number on the day-sweep strip (null = off the strip). Keep en.headline short (heroes about 40 characters, cards about 36, briefs about 52). Re-render with: node render-entry.mjs In a zh headline, '|' marks where a line may break (Chinese lines break only there and after punctuation); it is never drawn.
